digest.component_or_area: authorship fixture / batched ticket map resolution
propositions: The test fixture equivalence assertion incorrectly required a raw call to build_ticket_position_commit_map to succeed on first attempt, despite the function's contract explicitly returning empty map on Git transient failures (rc!=0, empty output, process exception).

Runtime injection of rc=128/empty, rc=0/empty, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) each reproduced the observed sequence: first batched call returns empty map, immediate identical replay returns complete 8-entry map in unchanged repository.

Deleting the previously implicated loose blob left both broad history walk (rc=0, 804 bytes) and narrow per-event walk healthy, refuting the prior missing-object ENOENT class as cause of the batched-empty recurrence.

The test harness lacked bounded Git-read recovery already established in tests/_git_counts.py, causing fixture-level assertions to fail on documented transient boundaries that production callers handle via per-event fallback.

Fixture-only _fixture_batched_map was added to perform at most five exact resolver attempts, return on first complete map, raise with fsck/count-objects diagnostics on persistent failure, and leave production authorship behavior unchanged.

Test oracle was RED before fix (missing second attempt and diagnostics), GREEN after fix, RED again under omitted-recovery mutation; optimization-count sibling independently fixed; local suite and Ubuntu CI lane (environment of original failure) both green after merge.
